# GloBE Model Rules (Pillar Two)

> HTML rendering of the OECD Global Anti-Base Erosion Model Rules (December 2021). Every article has its own page; every paragraph and defined term has an anchor.

## How to navigate

- Article: /articles/{chapter}.{article} (e.g. /articles/3.2)
- Paragraph: /articles/{chapter}.{article}#{chapter}.{article}.{paragraph} (e.g. /articles/3.2#3.2.6), or the shortcut /{paragraph} (e.g. /3.2.6) which redirects there
- Chapter: /chapters/{n} (1-10)
- Defined term: /definitions#{slug} (lower-case, hyphenated, e.g. /definitions#qualified-iir)
- Whole text as JSON: /model-rules.json; one article as JSON: /articles/{id}.json
- Search: /search?q={query}
